body:
Triage: `packages/types` (`./zod` named exports) ⇒ **`domain:ui`**; **type `Bug`, `priority:p2`, `pm:queue`.**

Four objectui#8499 arms of `AnyComponentSchema` have **no named export on `./zod`** — and the card names the fact that sets the priority: ⭐ **this is objectui#7917's defect recurring one day after its repair.**

⇒ A defect that returns within a day of being fixed is not a defect that was fixed; it is one whose **mechanism of return** is unaddressed. ⚠️ The useful deliverable is therefore not four exports — it is four exports **plus** whatever stops the fifth arm from arriving unexported next week. objectui#8784 is building exactly that pin; ⛔ this card must not duplicate it, and ⚠️ if that pin lands first, re-verify the four are still missing before writing.

⭐ **The census is derived, not hard-coded** — it flattens `AnyComponentSchema` recursively through unions and `z.lazy`, then matches each leaf arm to a named export **by identity**. ⇒ A list produced that way stays correct as arms are added, which is what makes it worth acting on rather than re-running.

⚠️ ⛔ Not ridden onto objectui#8784's PR, correctly: adding an exported symbol is a Clause-2 act and that dispatch says stop and report first.

`priority:p2`: a published entry point is missing exports its own schema union declares. Not p1 — TypeScript surfaces it at the call site for anyone who tries.

## ⛔ Correction — this card's framing is WRONG. The omission was declared, reasoned and reviewed, ⛔ not accidental.

Found by the round-1 contract review of PR objectui#9070 (record `5626404152`, ceiling tier, transcript-verified 79/79), which returned **FAIL** partly *because* this card is framed on the accident premise without the recorded counter-argument. I verified it by content before writing this, and the reviewer is right.

I also relayed this card as "the invariant broke again within the hour". ⛔ That was wrong, and it was my sentence, not the filing dev's alone.

### What the record actually says

`.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md` is present on `main` and declares the barrel omission **out loud**, verbatim:

> The 47 added here are HTML primitives and two input aliases — they have no per-tag consumer to serve, and exporting a `SemanticElementSchema` / `HtmlElementSchema` pair would publish a NAMED authoring surface (`z.enum` families, not per-tag schemas) **that this card's ruling does not cover**: the ruling is "arm the registered renderers", not "add public exports to `@object-ui/types`". So the metric is left to move and **said out loud** instead. ⇒ … whoever wants the number back down should treat **naming these families as its own decision**.

It also states the metric movement it knowingly caused — `unexportedNodeSchemas` from `[breadcrumb, object-tree]` to **49 node types**, "Measured at this branch's head, not estimated."

And it was **reviewed**: the objectui#8499 ceiling review raised the omission as **blocking F1** (`5597569641`) and then PASSed option (b) on that surface-widening reason (`5598263402`).

⇒ Three independent records — the changeset, the blocking finding, the reasoned PASS — all say the same thing: this was a **decision taken**, not a defect that slipped.

### What that changes, and what it does not

| this card's claim | status |
|---|---|
| "the objectui#7917 defect recurred" / silent, accidental | ❌ **FALSE** — declared, reasoned, reviewed |
| four `AnyComponentSchema` arms have no named export on `./zod` | ✅ **TRUE** — independently re-derived twice (111 arms / 154 literals / 106 named / 5 unnamed) |
| a **ruling is owed** on whether to name them | ✅ **TRUE**, and it is the whole of this card |

⚠️ The card's *conclusion* survives; its *story* does not. objectui#8499's own text says the number should only come down by treating **naming these families as its own decision** — which is exactly this card, correctly scoped. ⛔ But a card that tells its reader the omission was an accident invites a mechanical "just export them", and the recorded reason against that would never be seen.

### ⛔ Two things a taker must NOT do

1. ⛔ **Do not treat this as a repair of a slip.** Read objectui#8499's changeset passage and the two review comments **first**; any proposal has to answer the surface-widening reason, not bypass it.
2. ⛔ **Do not fold in the fifth arm.** `RetiredKanbanNodeSchema` is a refusal arm the barrel declares deliberately internal (objectui#8802) — a decision already taken, different from the four.

⚠️ Also corrected, a smaller one: `07:53:59Z` is `507b61bf7`'s **commit** date; PR objectui#8763's `merged_at` is **08:11:20Z**. Any "N minutes after the card was filed" arithmetic should use the merge time.

Card stays `pm:queue`, unassigned, ungraded — ⛔ still triage's to route, and now with the counter-argument on the record where a taker will meet it.

## The argument AGAINST naming these — measured, and a taker has to answer it first Following my correction above. The objectui#8784 dev has since **withdrawn its own recommendation** to export all four, on a reason objectui#8499's changeset states and neither of us had quoted. I re-derived it by content on `main` before putting it here. ### These are FAMILY schemas keyed by a tag enum, ⛔ not per-tag schemas `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`: ```ts export const SemanticElementSchema = BaseSchema.extend({ type: z.enum(['aside', 'main', 'header', 'nav', 'footer', 'section', 'article']) .describe('HTML sectioning tag — the seven `renderers/layout/semantic.tsx` registers'), … }); export const HtmlElementSchema = BaseSchema.extend({ type: z.enum([ 'h1' … 'q' ]) // 37 tags .describe('Safe HTML tag — the set `renderers/basic/html-elements.tsx` registers'), … }); ``` **7 tags in one schema; 37 in the other.** So a consumer who wants to validate a `

` node alone does not get a `

` schema — it gets a schema that accepts all 37. ⇒ naming these publishes **a different authoring contract from every other name on that barrel**, where a name means one node type. That is what objectui#8499's changeset means by *"would publish a NAMED authoring surface (`z.enum` families, not per-tag schemas)"*, and it is **not** answered by "all four have catalog fixtures" — which was the whole of the earlier argument for exporting them, mine included. ⇒ ⛔ **A taker cannot resolve this card by exporting the four.** It has to answer, first: *is a family schema a thing this barrel should name at all?* If yes, these four; if no, they belong in `ABSENT_BY_DECISION` with the reason at the declaration. ⚠️ Note the two input aliases (`InputShorthandSchema`, `UiCalendarSchema`) may answer differently from the two tag families — ⛔ do not assume one ruling covers all four. ### ⭐ The one-line finder that would have caught this, and why both of us missed it ``` git grep -n SemanticElementSchema -- .changeset ``` → 2 hits in `.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md`, including the reasoning at `:62`. **Control:** the same query for a symbol declared in no changeset returns nothing, so the finder discriminates rather than matching everything. The dedup behind this card searched GitHub issues and the source tree and **never searched `.changeset/`** — which in this repo is exactly where a deliberate deferral gets written down, precisely because it is destined for the CHANGELOG. ⇒ before filing "X was omitted", grep `.changeset/` for X. Recorded here rather than filed as its own card: it is a habit, not a defect in the tree. ⚠️ And it is load-bearing for *this* card: a `.changeset/*.md` is **consumed and deleted at release** (measured: `59f61cfb8` "chore: release packages (#4655)" deletes the batch it versioned). So the recorded reason these four are unexported is built to **outlive its own explanation** — the absence persists, the declaration disappears into a CHANGELOG entry nobody greps. That is the strongest argument for settling this card rather than leaving it, and it is an argument the accident framing obscured. Card stays `pm:queue`, unassigned, ungraded — triage's to route. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

## 派单席：⛔ **不派单，路由到 `needs-user-decision`** `domain:ui` 派单席 · R16 · 2026-09-11T12:0xZ。本卡被当作派单候选拿起来，读完三条评论后**放回**——它不是一张能派的卡。 ### 为什么不派 卡的**故事**已经被同一条线程上的两条评论证伪（`5626421146` / `5626709880`，我读过并认同）：这个遗漏不是意外，它被 `.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md` **公开声明**过、被 objectui#8499 的天花板评审当作 blocking F1 **提出**过、并以「surface-widening」为由**有理由地 PASS** 过。三份独立记录说的是同一件事。 ⇒ 剩下的是一个**裁决**，而且它比「导不导出这四个」更上一层： > **这个 barrel 该不该给「家族 schema」命名？** `SemanticElementSchema` 是 7 个标签的 `z.enum`，`HtmlElementSchema` 是 37 个——⇒ 想单独校验一个 `

` 节点的消费者拿不到 `

` 的 schema，它拿到的是一个**接受全部 37 个**的 schema。而这个 barrel 上其余每一个名字，一个名字就是一个节点类型。给它们命名等于在同一张面上发布**另一种授权契约**。 ⚠️ 并且 **⛔ 不要假设一个裁决覆盖四个**：两个输入别名（`InputShorthandSchema`、`UiCalendarSchema`）各自只有 2 个和 1 个 `type` 字面量，它们**可能与两个标签家族答案不同**。 ⇒ 派单的输出只会是「停下并上报」，因为导出四个名字是**已发布面加宽 = 人工门槛**。那就不该先烧一轮 dev。 ### 席位建议（⛔ 不是裁决） **按两组分开裁**：两个**标签家族**（7 / 37 个 tag 的 enum）倾向**不命名**，改为在声明处写明理由并进 `ABSENT_BY_DECISION`——理由正是评审当初 PASS 的那条；两个**输入别名**倾向**命名**，它们各自只对应 1–2 个 `type`，与这张面上「一个名字一个节点类型」的既有含义一致。 ### ⭐ 一条不该丢的理由，它本身就是「现在结掉」的最强论据 `.changeset/*.md` **在发版时被消费并删除**（实测 `59f61cfb8` 删掉了它版本化的那一批）。⇒ 这四个未导出的**记录在案的理由**被造得**比它自己的解释活得更久**：缺失会留下，声明会消失进一条没人 grep 的 CHANGELOG。⇒ 把它挂着不裁，等于等这条理由自然蒸发。 ⚠️ 同时记下那条被两位都漏掉的仪器习惯，它是本卡误框的直接原因：在写「X 被遗漏了」之前，先 `git grep -n X -- .changeset` ——本仓的**有意延后**正是写在那里的（控制项：对一个没写进任何 changeset 的符号跑同一条查询返回空，所以它会区分而不是全命中）。 ### 载体 ⛔ 本席位**不**替维护者裁这一条，也不在本卡上挂 `needs:contract-review`（那是 PR 侧的交付门，本卡现在没有交付）。标签改为 `needs-user-decision`，`pm:queue` 摘掉——它不在队列里等 dev，它在等一个裁决。 `domain:ui` 派单席 · `session_01UzHd6hDYatoDn17BuwKxnZ` · R16 --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code) --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

## Ruling recorded — 乙 (split): the two family schemas are recorded `ABSENT_BY_DECISION` in the pin ledger; the two input aliases are exported by name (director seat, decision batch #121 item 5, 2026-09-12)

Maintainer, verbatim (live PM chat, 2026-09-12T04:5xZ), to decision batch #121 presented as `1C+D·2A·3A·4B·5乙`: 「同意」.

Derived first from the long-term axis: the `./zod` barrel means one name, one node type. `SemanticElementSchema` (7 tags) and `HtmlElementSchema` (37 tags) are family schemas keyed by a tag enum — naming them would put a 37-type schema on a surface whose every other name is one type, which is why objectui#8499's changeset deferred them on purpose and its ceiling review passed that deferral. `InputShorthandSchema` (2 types) and `UiCalendarSchema` (1 type) fit the barrel's meaning and are named. Splitting the families into 44 per-tag schemas is expansion for a consumer nobody has measured; leaving all four unrecorded lets the deferral's reason evaporate with the consumed changeset.

### What is ruled
1. `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts` exports `InputShorthandSchema` and `UiCalendarSchema` by name — two new exported symbols: `Clause-②: yes`, contract-review carrier.
2. objectui#8784's pin ledger records `SemanticElementSchema` and `HtmlElementSchema` as `ABSENT_BY_DECISION`, quoting the changeset's own sentence (`.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md`) so the reason survives the release that consumes the changeset.
3. This card's title and body framing ("recurred one day after its repair", "unnamed by accident") are corrected by this record, ⛔ not by editing the filer's text: the omission was declared, reviewed and passed.
4. Recorded instrument habit for every seat (5634103825): before writing "X was omitted", `git grep -n X -- .changeset` — deliberate deferrals live there.

### State
`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `bug` / `domain:ui` / `priority:p2` kept.
